# Ecoo Basket B2B

Official corporate website of Ecoo Hyper Retail Private Limited, operating the Ecoo Basket brand.

- Current delivery market: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
- Business: B2B FMCG wholesale and distribution for kirana stores, general trade, mini supermarkets and local businesses.
- Ordering website: https://www.ecoobasket.com
- Corporate website: https://ecoobasketb2b.com
- Growth strategy: Chennai-first density, followed by selective evaluation of metro, non-metro, Tier-2 and Tier-3 city clusters after service quality and unit economics are proven.
- Own-brand strategy: ECOO Nutzes and ECOO Spizees.
- Investor framework: recurring FMCG demand, retailer density, route economics, inventory rotation and capital velocity.

Future-market references are strategic and do not imply current delivery outside Chennai.
